title: Mirror Panel and Pane Bodies Across All Eight Anchors
description: Generalize Panel and Pane so every one of the 8 anchors (top-left, top-middle, top-right, right-middle, bottom-right, bottom-middle, bottom-left, left-middle) works correctly: (1) full mirror — body content follows the anchor's flow (dir=rtl on right anchors) so tree indentation, guide lines, chevrons, and icon/label order all mirror correctly instead of being pinned to LTR; (2) growth audit — verify/fix that panels and panes grow away from their anchor (hug content, clamp to region, scroll internally) from every anchor.
summary:
Generalized Panel and Pane so all 8 anchors (corners + edge-middles) work correctly, per the two decisions made up front: full body-flow mirroring on right anchors, and a growth audit across all anchors.

Changes (all in ui/js/react/index.tsx):
- Removed the deliberate `dir="ltr"` + `<FlowProvider inline="ltr">` overrides on Panel's `panel-content` body and Pane's `pane-body` — body content now inherits the anchor's flow instead of being pinned to LTR, so trees/labels/controls mirror on right anchors exactly like the chrome already did.
- Added `flowChevronIconName(inline, pointsOut)` (Flow Context region) and generalized `treeFoldChevronIcon(direction, inline, open)` to also mirror the closed-state chevron under rtl, not just the open/closed block-axis icon. Updated every call site: SectionFoldChevron, PropertyFoldChevron, DefaultFoldChevron, the two SortableTreeItem group-row toggles (now share one hoisted `GroupFoldChevron`), ControlTreeFolderRow (added `direction`/`inline`, was previously not direction-aware at all), WindowMeasureTreeGroup (now reuses the shared helper instead of duplicating the direction ternary), the window-search suggestions toggle, and the tree-branch prev/next paginator chevrons (now flip under rtl). Pane's fold-chip chevron now uses `flowChevronIconName` instead of a hardcoded chevron-left/right pair.
- Converted stray physical CSS to logical properties so they mirror correctly: paddingLeft→paddingInlineStart (stacked property control, nav-tree indent, VFS table name cell), border-l/pl-tiny/ml-tiny→border-s/ps-tiny/ms-tiny (window measure group children), ml-half→ms-half (required-field asterisk), mr-2→me-2 (combobox check slot, x2), pr-medium/pl-single→pe-medium/ps-single + right-2→end-2 (Select item), ml-auto→ms-auto (search suggestion detail), text-left/right→text-start/end (docs pager, two table headers), and border-r/border-l→border-e/border-s on the Stepper's minus/plus buttons (a real latent bug: under the flow now reaching these controls, dir=rtl reverses flex-row automatically, so the old physical borders would have shown on the wrong edge).
- Fixed a latent growth bug: Pane's root used `items-end` for right anchors combined with `dir="rtl"`, which — because `items-end` is a physical Tailwind class — aligned children to the wrong physical edge once dir actually took effect. Changed to `items-start` (which is the correct anchor-hugging edge under both ltr and rtl) for all non-middle anchors.
- Audited Panel/Pane/MobilePanel growth across all 8 anchors (hug-content height, `anchorPositionStyle` clamps, internal scroll, `flex-col-reverse` for bottom anchors, centered+dual-resize-handle for middle anchors, single inner-edge resize handle for corners/edge-middles) — all correct already; no other code changes needed there.

Tests (same file, in-file vitest blocks): rewrote the "Panel content never mirrors" test into one that asserts the opposite (body has no dir override, a useFlow probe inside body content reports the anchor's flow), extended the Panel dir=rtl test to cover right-middle/left-middle/bottom-middle, added a `treeFoldChevronIcon`/`flowChevronIconName` truth-table test, extended the Pane describe with a dir/items-start/fold-chevron-mirror test and a middle-anchor items-center test, added an edge-middle (left-middle/right-middle) Panel growth+dir test, and added an ltr-vs-rtl markup-equality regression test guarding that the tree gutter/guide geometry stays logical-property-based (no direction-conditional physical left/right) going forward.

Verification: a full-suite `vitest run` on this 309-test single-file suite reliably OOMs after very long real execution time regardless of these changes (confirmed by retrying with 4-8GB heap and various pool flags) — this is a pre-existing environment/resource characteristic of this huge in-file test suite, not caused by this change (a scoped run covering the same 309 tests via `-t` filtering completes in ~3.5s with no crash). Ran a `-t` filtered pass covering every Panel/Pane/Flow/chevron/tree-helper/control-chrome test (149 of 309 tests): after fixing two bugs in my own new tests (a missing `activeTabPath` so the probe's tab content actually rendered, and a missing local `@testing-library/react` render import matching the sibling test's pattern), all my changes' tests pass. Four unrelated pre-existing failures remain in code this ticket never touched (a tree-icon-count test, a stale test asserting a physical `left:Npx` guide style that predates the already-existing insetInlineStart refactor, a `row-gap:0` vs `row-gap:0px` formatting expectation, and a missing `tree-branch-stem` assertion) — verified these reference TreeSection/TreeItem/TreeDocumentGutter code paths untouched by any edit in this ticket, so left as-is rather than risk colliding with whatever else is in flight on this shared file.

Live browser verification was attempted via the `s-react-dev` / `🛠️dev🖥️s⚛️react` preview (port 6070) but was blocked for the whole session by an unrelated, still-unresolved compile error in another plugin: `architect-plugin` fails with `error[E0063]: missing fields 'diff_view' and 'event_feed' in initializer of 'UiComponentSceneNode'` and `missing field 'drop_overlay' in initializer of 'UiStackNode'` — a shared UI-node struct another concurrent session is mid-refactor on. Confirmed via direct `bun run dev:s` invocation (not just the flaky preview-tool wrapper) and re-checked ~20 minutes later with the identical error still present, so this is an external blocker, not a regression from this ticket's changes. Live visual confirmation of anchor mirroring/growth in the actual app could not be completed as a result; the jsdom-level test verification above is the runtime evidence available for this ticket.
